name: Shoulder Rolls
description: Slow circles to loosen up tight shoulders.

steps.title: Sit or stand tall
steps.text: Let your arms hang loosely by your sides and take an easy breath.

steps.title: Roll back
steps.text: Lift your shoulders up toward your ears, then roll them back and down. Do this five times, slowly.

steps.title: Roll forward
steps.text: Now roll them forward in the opposite direction, five slow times.

steps.title: Let them drop
steps.text: Let your shoulders rest and notice how they feel. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
